test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which missile defence system, named Sudarshan Chakra, was used by India to intercept drones and missiles during Pakistan’s attempted strikes in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**S-400 Triumf**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **S-400 Triumf** is one of the most advanced air defense systems in the world, developed by Russia.
 
• India signed a $5.43 billion deal with Russia in October 2018 to purchase the **S-400 Triumf** systems for its defense capabilities.
 
• The S-400 can intercept and destroy a wide range of aerial threats, including **aircraft, drones, and ballistic missiles**, at a range of up to 400 kilometers.
 
• It employs advanced radar systems and multiple missile types to ensure high precision and effectiveness against various threats.
 
• India deployed the S-400 system to strengthen its defense capabilities against Pakistan and China in high-tension scenarios.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Technical Features of S-400 Triumf:**

 
 
• It uses **four types of missiles** capable of engaging targets at short, medium, and long ranges.
 
• Equipped with **multi-function radar**, autonomous detection, targeting systems, and anti-jamming capabilities.
 
• Can simultaneously track and engage up to **80 targets**.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Importance for India:**
 
 
• The S-400 enhances India's ability to counter aerial threats, including stealth aircraft and UAVs.
 
• This system is considered pivotal for defending key areas and cities against hostile attacks.
 
 
 
• **India’s Missile Defense Systems:**
 
 
• In addition to the S-400, India operates the indigenous **Akash missile system** and has developed advanced systems like **Prithvi Air Defence** and **Barak 8**.
 
• The integration of the S-400 complements India's existing air defense architecture.
 
 
 
• **Global Deployment of S-400:**
 
 
• Countries like China and Turkey have also acquired the S-400, showcasing its global demand and effectiveness.
 
• Russia has deployed the system extensively to protect its critical infrastructure.
